'''2014 US Nationals Day 1 Justin Carulli DS The Force Unleashed''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Justin Carulli]] at [[2014 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Force Unleashed|VB4-D-theforceunleashed-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
